properties.title: GitCafe

overview_description.description:
Shanghai Donggezhi Information Technology Co., Ltd., a Chinese company, offers GitCafe, a socializing service platform of code management, technical writing, and sharing.

The company is devoted to improving the education environment. GitCafe is the first product released by the company. It is a platform for code version control solutions that helps open-source enthusiasts, business software project teams, and enterprises. Programming enthusiasts are able to host the code of open-sources or business projects they wrote in GitCafe by using the code version control system, to cooperate with other programmers and develop projects online.

Donggezhi Information Technology was established in 2011.
